protocol.question: Do selections and later-period comparisons change when the original validation grids use equal-tournament rather than equal-match loss?
protocol.candidate_grids: Reuse the six pair k values, sixteen (k_o,k_s) values, and seven joint-scale configurations without extension.
protocol.sequential_selection: Select k_p under each objective, freeze that value for its player grid, and let overall records inherit the selected k_o. Reuse candidate forecasts when selected k_p agrees.
protocol.fixed: Logistic C=1; overall k_s=1e9; player-adjustment weight=1; joint fitting objective, penalty, solver, and convergence; data, cutoffs, updating, and scoring.
protocol.tie_rule: First candidate in original grid order.
protocol.selection_boundary: Save both selections before opening October for forecasts or scoring later periods. Historical evaluation and October never select settings.
protocol.evaluation: Rerun only models whose settings differ; reuse saved original predictions for unchanged models. July 2024-September 2026 is primary; January 2025-September 2026 overlaps; October fits are frozen before October 1.
protocol.precision: Historical probabilities and losses independently rounded to six decimals as in the paper; October probabilities use full precision.
protocol.uncertainty: Existing paired four-month historical blocks and independent-tournament October bootstrap, 5000 draws, seed 20261011; conditional on selection.
protocol.publication: Full candidate scores, selections, aggregate evaluation comparisons, report and provenance are saved in results/tuning_objective/ for publication; per-match files remain in the external workspace.
